recognize_zh: 整個視野幾乎所有紅血球都是長橢圓形到棒狀的橢圓形紅血球（elliptocytes），大小與色素大致一致、兩端鈍圓，沒有明顯碎片或微球形細胞，符合遺傳性橢圓形紅血球增多症。
features: Majority (>50%) of red cells are elliptocytes and ovalocytes, some elongated rod-like forms
Elliptocytes are normochromic with blunt rounded ends and relatively uniform size
No significant fragmented cells, microspherocytes or budding forms in this field
No teardrop cells, target cells or red cell inclusions
No leukocytes or platelets clumps included in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a red cell population composed predominantly of elliptocytes and ovalocytes, including elongated rod-like forms, accounting for well over half of the red cells. The cells are normochromic with blunt ends and relatively uniform size. Red cell fragments, microspherocytes, teardrop cells, and inclusions are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with hereditary elliptocytosis; correlation with family history, hemolytic markers, and membrane protein or genetic studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: HPP shows marked microcytosis with fragments, budding cells and microspherocytes in addition to elliptocytes, which are absent here.
Pencil cells in iron deficiency are hypochromic and microcytic and accompany anisocytosis, rather than a uniform normochromic elliptocyte population.
Acquired elliptocytes occur with teardrop cells, leukoerythroblastosis or dysplastic changes rather than as a uniform predominant population.
SAO cells are rounder, macro-ovalocytic stomatocytes with one or two transverse bars or slits.
